2025_109_march_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's PCARD report for March 2025 is a line-item schedule of purchasing-card activity carried on the Board of Education agenda for the May 20, 2025 meeting. Each row records a transaction description, the journal-entry description "MAR 2025 PCARD EXP", a district accounting code, a transaction date, a transaction amount and any offsetting credit, with posting dates running from 2/24/25 through 3/25/25. The schedule runs 43 pages, each footed 5/15/25, and closes with a reported total of 357,294.34.
